title: Technical English — Course 3, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 9

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the demonstration take place?
tasks.audioText: The quality department is demonstrating its new inspection report template on Thursday at eleven thirty. The demonstration will take place in Meeting Room B. Students will see how to record the component ID, inspection date, measured values and any non-conforming result. A sample report will be uploaded to the course folder after the session.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which room will be used?
tasks.audioText: The quality department is demonstrating its new inspection report template on Thursday at eleven thirty. The demonstration will take place in Meeting Room B. Students will see how to record the component ID, inspection date, measured values and any non-conforming result. A sample report will be uploaded to the course folder after the session.

tasks.prompt: After checking a batch of training components, a quality assistant prepared an inspection report. Most measurements were within the specified limits, but one item did not meet the drawing requirement. The assistant recorded the actual value, identified the component and described the issue clearly. The report was then sent to the supervisor for review before the batch status was updated. Reading 1. What did the assistant do when one item did not meet the requirement?
options: Recorded the actual value, identified the component and described the issue

tasks.prompt: Who received the report for review?
The report ___ to the supervisor for review.
Choose TWO details that belong in an inspection report.
options: A personal opinion about the operator

tasks.prompt: A result that does not meet a specified requirement is a ___.
You find a result outside the specified limits. What is the best response?
options: Change the value so that it looks acceptable.
Record the actual result and report the non-conformity through the correct process.
Leave the result out of the report.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of inspection reports in a logical order.
options: Compare the result with the specified limits
Identify the component and inspection requirement
correctOrder: Identify the component and inspection requirement
Compare the result with the specified limits

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words explaining what makes an inspection report clear and useful. Include component identification, measured values and reporting of a non-conformity.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: component identification and measured values are included in the inspection report (0–2); the non-conformity is described against a stated requirement using factual evidence, without changing original results (0–2); the report structure is clear with understandable grammar (0–2); inspection/non-conformity vocabulary, spelling and punctuation are accurate (0–2).
